craft_notes: Sthāyin: smallness as the whole verse. Sanskrit-first: aṇutva (SMALLNESS — kept ‘done small’; size-true). Rows: 1 (‘done small’ closes), 5 (two-beat: acts, then size). Close: ‘done small’. Rupture: em-dash (acts stated, then their size). Rejected: ‘lesser’ — killed: small is size-true; joining beats — killed: two beats. Read aloud: THOSE-ver-y-ACTS — … DONE-small.

reads_against.argmap: How does the bound one still act divinely? → Agency kept through contraction: likeness stained, five acts still done.
c1_essence: Stained likeness keeps divine office: five acts done small is wandering.
